    (hf : LR.Stable W f) : LR.Stable W (c • f) := by
  intro w hw
  exact W.smul_mem c (hf w hw)

    (n : ℕ) : LR.Stable W (f ^ n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro w hw
      simpa using hw
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact hmul (f ^ n) f ih hf
